# Seaworth

> Marine Security as a Service. Seaworth provides autonomous maritime protection:
> our vessels escort commercial ships through high-risk passages, protecting
> them from piracy and drone attacks.

The company is currently in stealth. Based in Brooklyn, NY.

## What it is

Seaworth operates autonomous security vessels that travel alongside commercial
cargo ships transiting high-risk waters. The escort vessel is unmanned and
provides protection against piracy, armed boarding attempts, drone attacks and other aerial threats.

The service is sold to commercial shipping operators. Seaworth allows commercial
ships to pass through. It is not associated with any military and does not sell
to military organizations.

## Threats addressed

- Piracy and armed boarding
- Drone attacks
- Aerial threats
- Maritime threats in high-risk passages

## High-risk passages

Panama Canal, Strait of Gibraltar, Suez Canal and Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb,
Bosporus Strait, Strait of Malacca, Cape of Good Hope.
